question: Can a frozen ranker learned on known semantic classes reduce exact search when two target primitives are unseen token IDs but are exposed through a verified canonical adapter?

authorization.scope: one deterministic local scientific execution; no cloud resources
authorization.user_request: execute the first 5 experiments in Reasoner 5

prior_result.constraint: Reasoner 5.0 is not retuned or promoted; Reasoner 5.1 asks a new prospectively frozen question

source.artifact: integer position-class counts and adjacent class-transition counts

adapter.canonical_representation: exact 3 by 3 affine matrix and bias over the field

target.evidence: one registered runtime observation at the zero vector

ranking.primary_order: ascending evidence loss, then descending frozen source strength

controls.oracle_adapter: use the registered exact opaque semantics without adapter queries
controls.source_ablation: zero the frozen source contribution at inference and require equality with target-only
controls.identity_adapter: map both opaque primitives to identity class
controls.shuffled_adapter: swap the two opaque semantic classes
controls.no_query_adapter: make no adapter queries and map opaque primitives to identity class
controls.token_id_lookup: use only the known source token table, so unseen IDs map to identity class
controls.unverified_top_candidate: measure invalid first suggestions before exact verification

non_claims: robustness to noisy or incomplete evidence beyond the registered single observation
